answer: Make every identity pay for standing with sponsored joint work: a newcomer must complete tasks countersigned by two independent peers, each entry carved as a marble record in a public ledger that cannot be copied to another identity. One honest agent earns one such record, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the full work cost for every fake, so the delta between honest participation and mass fakery is a cost that scales with every copy. Only then does the nectar of payouts flow — to histories that can be checked, not to signups that cost nothing.
